name: animated-number
title: Animated Number
blurb: Number that springs to new values with custom formatting.
description: Spring-animated number using Framer Motion. Supports precision, custom formatting, and animation lifecycle callbacks. Configurable spring physics.
use_when: Displaying metric changes, counters, or scores with smooth animation.
avoid_when: When animation is disabled or in performance-critical contexts.
a11y: Animated value updates via MotionValue. Screen readers see formatted text content.
